CUnitter frame-length formulas extracted from code; MSV 16k frame size RESOLVED = 128 B (CUnitterLpecSp mode 0x00/C0), confirmed on 07011600.MSV (exactly 159.0 continuous 1024-bit frames, 96.2% type-0). synthesis_structure.objects: LPEC{engine 0xd00 (FUN_100065b0), wrapper 0x3a0 (FUN_10004c50), pump 0x540 vtable@0x100469e0, enc-pump 0x540 vtable@0x100469c0}
synthesis_structure.decode_flow: Decode(out,in,n): in->pump+0x538, n->+0x53c, clear +0x404, call vtable+0x14 refill, then FUN_100059e0(wrapper,out)
synthesis_structure.core_FUN_10005040: per frame: pump vtable+8 reset; 2-bit type; type0: 1-bit block, then 2x(1-bit presence + [7-bit pgidx]); page ptr = idx*0x40 + state+0xc8; presence0 -> empty-page marker DAT_10046a00; FUN_10004960 excitation build; FUN_1000f430/f1c0 windowed overlap-add into double buffer wrapper+0x380; final FUN_1000ef20(n_rest) consumes frame remainder with per-type budgets at wrapper+0x1c/0x20/0x24/0x28; FUN_100059e0 rounds/clips to PCM16 (saturate 0x7fff/0x8000)
synthesis_structure.frame_types: 0 = normal speech; 1/3 = degraded single-block (state +0x8c table); 2 = CNG/hold paths
synthesis_structure.setparams_FUN_10003e60: per-type budgets: nominal N, +0x20 = N*3/4, +0x24 = N*5/4; engine +0x2c=8/10, +0xa4=10/16 (LPC window order), +0xac=6, +0xb0=3/4; 6000 bps special case local_30=0x20 param_2=0xdac
synthesis_structure.tables_used: window DAT_10049f7c (0x1004f840 8k / 0x100628a0 16k) -> state+0x150; page tables state+0xcc family (0x100390d0 16k / 0x100394d0 8k per F-48 inventory); LSF/window DAT_10049bb0 at +0x368
